<thought>The exact mass 134.10955 matches the calculated monoisotopic mass of C10H14 (10 × 12.00000 + 14 × 1.007825 = 134.10955). The M+1 intensity (~11 % of base) is consistent with ~10 carbons (≈10 × 1.1 % ≈ 11 %). No additional heteroatoms are needed to explain the mass or isotopic pattern.</thought>
<final_answer>C10H14</final_answer>
